Since these data were generated with a different protocol, could you please give me some suggestions for taking care of the parameters for subread alignment and featureCounts. What commands line should be precisely used for alignment and quantification.
I am waiting for your kind reply with anticipation.
Kind regards,
Ami

messages.subject: What is the status of coverageCount?
messages.subject_clean: What is the status of coverageCount?
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I noticed that Subread 1.6.3 no longer builds the executable coverageCount. Was this intentional? There is no mention in the changelog <http://subread.sourceforge.net/> that this feature was deprecated. Also, I couldn't find anything when I searched the mailing list for coverageCount <https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/subread/coverageCount%7Csort:date>.

Here are the steps I took to verify this:

docker run -it --rm ubuntu
apt-get update
apt-get install -y gcc make wget zlib1g-dev
# 1.6.2
wget https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/subread/subread-1.6.2/subread-1.6.2-source.tar.gz <http://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/subread/subread-1.6.2/subread-1.6.2-source.tar.gz>
tar xzf subread-1.6.2-source.tar.gz
cd subread-1.6.2-source/src
make -f Makefile.Linux
cd ../..
#1.6.3
wget https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/subread/subread-1.6.3/subread-1.6.3-source.tar.gz <http://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/subread/subread-1.6.3/subread-1.6.3-source.tar.gz>
tar xzf subread-1.6.3-source.tar.gz
cd subread-1.6.3-source/src
make -f Makefile.Linux
cd ../..
# Compare
diff <(ls subread-1.6.2-source/bin/) <(ls subread-1.6.3-source/bin/)
diff <(ls subread-1.6.2-source/bin/utilities/) <(ls subread-1.6.3-source/bin/utilities/)
# 1d0
# < coverageCount

Thanks,

John
